status: EXPLORATORY — does not replace the pre-registered 0.5/0.5 baseline
description: Pre-registration for a strike-distance grid search. Written and committed before any backtesting code for this experiment is written or run. No P&L has been computed at the time this file is created.

grid.units_note: Values are percentages away from that day's index open, matching the convention already used to describe the pre-registered baseline (0.5 = 0.5%). config/strategy.json stores this as a fraction (strike_distance_pct: 0.005); this file uses the same percentage convention as the human-readable baseline label ('0.5/0.5') to avoid ambiguity about which grid cell is the existing baseline.

primary_selection_note: total_pnl_points on the tune_set is the SOLE metric used to choose a winning combination. No other metric listed below, and no metric not listed at all, may be used for selection -- including after the fact. If a future analysis is tempted to prefer a combination for a reason other than total_pnl_points on the tune_set, that is a new, separate, and differently-labeled experiment, not a continuation of this one.
holdout_rule: The holdout set is examined exactly ONCE, after a single winning combination has been selected on the tune set. No re-selection after seeing holdout results is permitted. If the holdout contradicts the tune-set result, that contradiction is the finding and must be reported as such.

reporting_units.secondary: rupees using per-contract NewBrdLotQty (not a flat lot size)

volume_filter.note: Unchanged from the pre-registered baseline (config/strategy.json). Applied identically across all 9 grid combinations.
